programme.title: Area 51: The CIA's Secret Files
programme.desc: The documentary presents the history of "Area 51", an air military base located in the desert near Las Vegas.The base was established in 1955, but its existence was officially confirmed only in 2013.This place is shrouded in legends because it is surrounded by a prohibited air zone of 1,140 square kilometers.The base developed programs that determined American dominance in military aviation from the Cold War to operations in Iraq and Afghanistan.Spy planes tested there were often mistaken for UFOs.The film features eyewitnesses to the creation of subsequent super-secret projects.Declassified CIA documents were used in the production.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: On April 26, 1986, an explosion destroyed the fourth block of the Chernobyl power plant.The accident was caused by design defects in the reactor and errors during the safety test.It was the worst nuclear disaster in history.The explosion released 400 times more radiation than the bomb dropped on Hiroshima.40 years after the tragedy, its consequences will be shown - from KGB activities to military operations in Ukraine.There will be plenty of witness accounts that will shed new light on the dramatic events.The speakers will include:a liquidator working on the roof of reactor 3, and journalist Wyatt Andrews, who was covering the information blackout in Moscow.

programme.desc: Albert Lin explores ancient cities and learns the secrets of ancient builders.The respected scientist completed, among others:a search expedition for Genghis Khan's tomb in Mongolia.The researcher once again sets out on an extraordinary mission.Viewers will be able to watch him wander through the jungle, trying to find objects related to the Mayan settlement.As always, it is equipped with modern devices that allow you to scan the surroundings.The National Geographic envoy is not afraid of risk.He will break through untouched areas, cross wild rivers and slide down a rope into a giant cave.He will undertake all these daring feats to solve another mystery from the past Albert Lin is an engineer and researcher at the University of California.He gained worldwide fame as a traveler and explorer who uses the latest technological achievements during his escapades.He reaches places inaccessible to average people - such as caves or hidden ruins of monumental buildings.His bionic leg prosthesis does not prevent him from performing feats requiring high physical fitness.The new series with his participation is a record of a fascinating expedition to ancient cities.Its motto is that history still hides many secrets from archaeologists that can revise our view of the past.Secrets of the Mayan Cradle Palenque is an archaeological site in Mexico.Here lived the people who built, among other things, the Temple of Inscriptions built on a step pyramid.Its discovery became a sensation, but this extraordinary place is still full of secrets.Modern technology allows you to explore the jungle, the bottom of a water-filled crater or the interior of a mountain in a way that was unavailable to archaeologists of the past.Viewers will, among other things, witness Albert Lin's exciting descent into an underground cave.They will see what a traveler will discover in a place considered sacred.
